name: matt-implement-adapter
description: Runs multi-ticket Matt implement work as one fresh sequential Codex subagent per ticket.

interface.shortDescription: Fresh Codex context and commit for every Matt ticket.
interface.longDescription: Adapts Matt's multi-ticket implement flow to Codex by running each approved implementation ticket in a fresh sequential subagent. Every ticket completes its own TDD, review, validation, and commit before the next ticket starts.
defaultPrompt: Implement the approved tickets in dependency order.
